GOOD TO KNOW

A few things,
before you start.

Clear expectations make better scripts.

Does Shellify run my script?

No. Shellify builds and previews scripts in your browser. You choose when and where to run the exported PowerShell.

Is this an AI script generator?

Shellify uses 53 predefined command templates and deterministic offline search. It generates from supported actions and the values you provide.

Where does my work get saved?

Drafts, favorites, and your script library are saved on this browser and device. Export a .shellify.json project for a portable copy.

What do I need to run the output?

Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7 on Windows, plus the permissions and modules required by your commands. The builder shows requirements; Active Directory commands require a compatible RSAT module.
